lines.en: : Wait, Yuki? What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 等等,Yuki?你在这里干什么?

lines.en: : What am I doing here?...
lines.zh: : 我在这里干什么?……

lines.en: : What...are you doing here?...
lines.zh: : 你……在这里干什么?……

lines.en: : And what the fuck happened...to all of my shit?
lines.zh: : 还有我的那些东西……发生了什么鬼事?

lines.en: : I...live here. With my rat son. And this is his rat father, Akira.
lines.zh: : 我……住这里。和我的老鼠儿子。这位是他的老鼠爸爸,Akira。

lines.en: : Oh good. Another animal to co-parent. Just what I wanted.
lines.zh: : 哦,太好了。又多了一个要共同抚养的动物。正是我梦寐以求的。

lines.en: : Hey...I know that guy...
lines.zh: : 嘿……我认识那个人……

lines.en: : I know you too, Yuki. Would you like to explain what’s going on right now?
lines.zh: : 我也认识你,Yuki。你愿意解释一下现在这是什么状况吗?

lines.en: : Nnnnnnnnnnnope.
: Yup. Saw that coming.
lines.zh: : 看。料到了。

lines.en: : Mnh...the fuck happened to my rug?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我的地毯……怎么了?……

lines.en: : She hasn’t done this before, has she?
lines.zh: : 她以前没这样过,对吧?

lines.en: : Never.
lines.zh: : 从来没有。

lines.en: : Get the...fuck outta my...apartment......I’m trying to.....go...mnh......sleep....
: Yuki, do I need to call an ambulance?
lines.zh: : Yuki,我需要叫救护车吗?

lines.en: : You ain’t...gotta call shit...
lines.zh: : 你不用……叫任何东西……

lines.en: : What did you take?
lines.zh: : 你嗑了什么?

lines.en: : Fuckin...nothing...okay? Now...fuck off...
lines.zh: : 什么都没……嗑,行吗?现在……滚远点……

lines.en: : Akira?
lines.zh: : Akira?

lines.en: : Don’t look at me. I’ve been here the whole time.
lines.zh: : 别看我。我从头到尾都在这里。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you know her way better than I do.
lines.zh: : 是,但你比我了解她多了。

lines.en: : I just need to know if this is going to be a “hold her shoulders while she vomits into the toilet” night or an “I should have bought that NARCAN” night.
lines.zh: : 我只需要弄清楚:今晚是「扶着她的肩、陪她对马桶吐」的夜晚,还是「早知道就该买那支纳洛酮」的夜晚。

lines.en: : Probably the former if she’s still somewhat coherent right now. But you never know how this stuff will progress and-
lines.zh: : 如果她现在还算清醒,多半是前者。但你永远不知道这些东西会怎么发展,而且——

lines.en: : Just...let me fuckin’ die, okay?! Mnh! Mblmm...mmnh...
lines.zh: : 就……让我死了行吗?!嗯!唔姆……嗯嗯……

lines.en: : If you’re going to die, can you please crawl into one of the pre-drawn outlines? I was just talking about this a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 你要死的话,能不能爬进某个画好的粉笔轮廓里?我几分钟前刚聊过这个。

lines.en: : I wish I had something more to say than I did the last time I saw you like this.
lines.zh: : 我希望我能说出比上次见到你这副样子时更多的话。

lines.en: : What’d.....last time......say?.....
lines.zh: : 上次……你说……了什么?……

lines.en: : Unbelievable.
lines.zh: : 难以置信。

lines.en: : Why don’t you go home, Akira?
lines.zh: : 你怎么不回家,Akira?

lines.en: : And let you deal with this on your own?
lines.zh: : 然后让你一个人应付这个?

lines.en: : What, you think I’ve never had to nurse a junkie back to health before? Come on.
lines.zh: : 怎么,你以为我从没照顾过瘾君子戒断?拜托。

lines.en: : I’ll get her into bed and watch her for a few hours to make sure she’s okay. It’s clear you don’t want to see her like this, so just leave it to me.
lines.zh: : 我把她弄上床,守她几个小时,确认她没事。很明显你不想看到她这副样子,所以交给我。

lines.en: : At least let me help you carry her back to her apartment.
lines.zh: : 至少让我帮你把她抬回她的公寓。

lines.en: : No need. I’ll just keep her here. I bought a second futon in case Rin ever wanted to stay over. I’ll just sleep in that.
lines.zh: : 不用。我让她留在这。我买了一张备用蒲团,以防 Rin 哪天想留宿。我睡那张就行。

lines.en: : If Yuki wakes up in the middle of the night and wants to go back, she can. You really don’t have to worry about it.
lines.zh: : Yuki 半夜醒来想回去的话,随时可以。你真的不必操心。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : I’ve got this. Okay? You’ve already fulfilled your manly duties for the day by listening to what an old woman had to say about her daughter’s safety and how it relates to your penis.
lines.zh: : 我搞得定。好吗?你今天已经尽到了一个男人的义务——听一个老女人聊她女儿的安危,以及这和你的 penis 有什么关系。

lines.en: : Okay?
lines.zh: : 好吗?

lines.en: : I just don’t get it...
lines.zh: : 我就是搞不懂……

lines.en: : She was doing so well.
lines.zh: : 她明明好起来了。

lines.en: : It’s impossible to get it unless you’ve been there.
lines.zh: : 没经历过的人,不可能懂。

lines.en: : We’re all addicted to something, Akira. I’m sure you’ve got your vice as well.
lines.zh: : 我们每个人都有瘾,Akira。我确信你也有你的那一款。

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Are you really sure you’ll be okay?
lines.zh: : 你确定你应付得来?

lines.en: : Hey, Yuki! Want to have a sleepover? Stay silent for yes!
lines.zh: : 嘿,Yuki!要不要来个睡衣派对?同意就保持沉默!

lines.en: : See? She’s totally excited.
lines.zh: : 看?她超兴奋的。

lines.en: : Or dead.
lines.zh: : 或者是死了。

lines.en: : We’ll be fine either way. I know people. How do you think Rin gets her skulls?
lines.zh: : 反正两种结果都没事。我认识人。你以为 Rin 的那些骷髅哪来的?

lines.en: : Call me if anything goes wrong or gets worse.
lines.zh: : 出任何问题或情况恶化,给我打电话。

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : She probably just needs to sleep it off. I’ll talk to her in the morning.
lines.zh: : 她大概只需要睡一觉醒酒。我明早找她谈。

lines.en: : And I won’t take no for an answer this time.
lines.zh: : 这一次,她不答应我也不罢休。

lines.en: : Ooookay! Come on, junkie. Let’s get you into bed.
lines.zh: : 好————了!来吧,瘾君子。把你弄上床。
: 把你的……手……从我身上……拿开………我………没事……

lines.en: : Oh, you are? So I guess you just barged into my apartment because you changed your mind about hooking up with me then?
lines.zh: : 哦,你没事?所以我猜,你闯进我的公寓,是因为你改变了主意、想和我睡了?

lines.en: : You?
: Mhm. That’s what I thought.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我就知道。

lines.en: : I’m gonna take your shoes off. Continue to be high if you consent!
lines.zh: : 我帮你把鞋脱了。你若同意,请继续保持嗑嗨状态!

lines.en: : Got it. Jacket stays on. Just gonna check your arms first.
lines.zh: : 明白。外套留着。先检查你的手臂。

lines.en: : Don’t......you.....fucking.....
lines.zh: : 你……敢……他妈的……

lines.en: : There! All done. I’d check your thighs too, but I don’t think we’re at that level yet and I’m sure you’ll be okay.
lines.zh: : 好!检查完毕。大腿我也想查,但我觉得我们的关系还没到那一步,而且我确信你没事。

lines.en: : Here. Water.
lines.zh: : 给。水。

lines.en: : Shh...
: Sleep now, okay?
lines.zh: : 先睡,好吗?

lines.en: : I’ll keep an eye on you for as long as I can...
lines.zh: : 我会尽量久一点……守着你……

lines.en: Four hours, thirteen minutes, and eleven seconds.
lines.zh: : 四小时,十三分钟,十一秒。

lines.en: That was how long Rika Rokuhara watched an addict that night.
lines.zh: : 这是那一晚 Rika Rokuhara 守着一个成瘾者的时长。

lines.en: It wasn’t her first time. Nor was it her second, third, fourth, or fifth.
lines.zh: : 这不是她的第一次。也不是第二次、第三次、第四次或第五次。

lines.en: Come to think of it, she didn’t know how many times she’d done something like this now.
lines.zh: : 细想起来,她已经数不清自己做过多少次这种事了。

lines.en: It was sort of nostalgic in a way. But much worse than nostalgia normally is because there were no pleasant memories that clung to it in an effort to offset the bad ones.
lines.zh: : 某种意义上,这有点怀旧。但比通常的怀旧糟得多——因为没有任何美好的记忆攀附其上,好去中和那些坏的。

lines.en: When morning came, Yuki Yamaguchi awoke to an unfamiliar scent.
lines.zh: : 清晨来临,Yuki Yamaguchi 在一种陌生的气味中醒来。

lines.en: Strangely enough, however, this sort of unfamiliarity was familiar to her.
lines.zh: : 奇怪的是,这种「陌生」对她来说却很熟悉。

lines.en: She’d also lost count of something — how many times she’s betrayed herself.
lines.zh: : 她同样数不清另一件事——她背叛过自己多少次。

lines.en: How many relapses, rebounds, and restarts she’d made over the course of a life that had tacked at least two or three decades onto her age.
lines.zh: : 在一段给她的年龄额外贴上了两三十岁的人生里,她复发过多少次、反弹过多少次、重新开始过多少次。

lines.en: It was catching up to her now, just not in the ways she expected.
lines.zh: : 现在,报应追上来了。只是方式出乎她的意料。

lines.en: And that was particularly strange to her, because she always expected the worst.
lines.zh: : 而这尤其奇怪,因为她一向把最坏的结果都预演过。

lines.en: Who knew the worst would look like this?
lines.zh: : 谁能想到,最坏的结果竟是这样?

lines.en: : Where the...fuck?
lines.zh: : 这是……哪里?

lines.en: She noticed something.
lines.zh: : 她注意到了一件事。

lines.en: This something was strange too.
lines.zh: : 这件事也很奇怪。

lines.en: Someone had spent the night by her side. And this time, they didn’t have their way with her in the midst of her unconsciousness. Or at least she didn’t think she did.
lines.zh: : 有人陪她过了一整夜。而这一次,那个人没有趁她昏迷时对她为所欲为。至少她不觉得自己被碰过。

lines.en: Why was she here, though?
lines.zh: : 不过,她为什么会在这里?

lines.en: Zero hours, five minutes, and forty-three seconds.
lines.zh: : 零小时,五分钟,四十三秒。

lines.en: That was how long Yuki Yamaguchi watched someone she didn’t know what to say to.
lines.zh: : 这是 Yuki Yamaguchi 注视着一个「她不知道该说什么」的人的时长。

lines.en: : I can feel you staring at me.
lines.zh: : 我能感觉到你在盯着我。

lines.en: : Aren’t you going to say good morning?
lines.zh: : 你不打算说早安吗?

lines.en: : What am I doing here?
lines.zh: : 我为什么会在这里?

lines.en: : More important question — how do you feel? You were zonked out of your mind when you busted in last night.
lines.zh: : 更重要的问题——你现在感觉如何?你昨晚闯进来的时候,神志完全不在。

lines.en: : Hah...fuck.
: Sorry to get you involved. I’ll fuck off back to my place now.
lines.zh: : 把你卷进来,抱歉。我现在滚回我自己家。

lines.en: : No, stay.
lines.zh: : 不,留下。

lines.en: : Let’s talk.
lines.zh: : 我们聊聊。

lines.en: : I...appreciate the...gesture and shit...I ain’t really the talkin’ type, though.
lines.zh: : 我……感谢你的……好意什么的……但我不是那种爱聊天的人。

lines.en: : Hmm...
: What time is it right now?
lines.zh: : 现在几点了?

lines.en: : Think the alarm clock over there says...5:25, but I can’t really tell since there’s a...is that a fuckin’ rat in the way?
lines.zh: : 那边的闹钟好像是……5:25,但我看不太清,因为中间有个……那是只该死的老鼠吗?

lines.en: : That’s Frankenstein. He’s a good boy.
lines.zh: : 那是 Frankenstein。他是好孩子。

lines.en: : Cool name...I guess...
lines.zh: : 不错的名字……大概……

lines.en: : Yuki...Do you have any plans today, by any chance?
lines.zh: : Yuki……你今天有什么安排吗,不巧问问?

lines.en: : Just...being a sack of shit. Same as always.
lines.zh: : 就是……当一坨废物。一如既往。

lines.en: : Let’s go somewhere.
lines.zh: : 我们去个地方吧。

lines.en: : What, like...together? I know you let me crash here last night, but I ain’t really got the cash right now if you want me to, like...buy you breakfast or-
lines.zh: : 什么,就是……一起去?我知道你昨晚收留了我,但如果你是想让我……请你吃早饭什么的,我现在手头真的没钱——

lines.en: : I’ll buy you breakfast.
lines.zh: : 我请你吃早饭。

lines.en: : There’s somewhere else I want to go first, though.
lines.zh: : 不过,还有一个我想先去的地方。

lines.en: : The gym?...
lines.zh: : 健身房?……

lines.en: : Not a fan of working out? Need help learning how to use the machines?
lines.zh: : 不喜欢锻炼?需要人教你怎么用器械吗?

lines.en: : No, I...used to come here. Stopped, though.
lines.zh: : 不,我……以前常来。后来停了。

lines.en: : Free trial run out?
lines.zh: : 免费体验到期了?

lines.en: : Something like that, yeah.
lines.zh: : 差不多是那样,对。

lines.en: : Well, I just so happen to come here every day. And I’m allowed to bring a guest, so...if you’re ever looking for something to do that doesn’t involve getting high, feel free to tag along.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我碰巧每天都来这里。而且我可以带访客,所以……你要是想找点不涉及「嗑嗨」的事做,随时跟着来。

lines.en: : Man. You must really want to fuck me if you’re going to be my nurse and my personal trainer.
lines.zh: : 天。你又当护士又当私人教练,你一定是真想干我。

lines.en: : You forgot about breakfast. My addict-coddling spree has only just begun.
lines.zh: : 你忘了早饭。我的「纵容瘾君子」狂欢才刚刚开始。

lines.en: : What are you doing, Yuki?
lines.zh: : 你在做什么,Yuki?

lines.en: : Just...being a sack of shit. Same as always.
lines.zh: : 就是……当一坨废物。一如既往。

lines.en: : How old are you? Thirties, right?
lines.zh: : 你多大了?三十多,对吧?

lines.en: : Thirty-eight...
lines.zh: : 三十八……

lines.en: : Thirty-eight years old, and still running around like you’re invincible. Come on. We’ve gotta be more conscious about our bodies at this age. You know that, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 三十八岁了,还像刀枪不入一样到处乱跑。拜托。这个年纪,我们得更爱惜身体。你知道的,对吧?

lines.en: : You ain’t got the faintest fuckin’ idea.
lines.zh: : 你他妈根本一无所知。

lines.en: : Then talk to me. Why are you doing this to yourself? To your daughter? Do you have any idea how she’d feel if she found out?
lines.zh: : 那就跟我说说。你为什么要这样对自己?对你的女儿?你知不知道她要是发现了会是什么感受?

lines.en: : Yumi? Like she’d give a shit about that. No one knows better than her that I ain’t nothin’ but a lost cause.
lines.zh: : Yumi?她才不在乎那个。没人比她更清楚,我就是个无可救药的废物。

lines.en: : There’s no such thing as a lost cause. Even the worst people in the world have a chance to make things right if they try.
lines.zh: : 世上没有「无可救药」这回事。哪怕最坏的人,只要肯试,也有把事情做对的机会。

lines.en: : The fuck is right, though? The hell does that even mean? I ain’t hurtin’ anybody. Least not anymore. That ship’s already sailed. Then crashed into the goddamn dock and exploded into a million pieces.
lines.zh: : 「对」个屁?那到底是什么意思?我又没在伤害任何人。至少现在没有了。那艘船早就开了。然后撞上了该死的码头,炸成了碎片。

lines.en: : So find another ship.
lines.zh: : 那就再找一艘船。

lines.en: : I did.
lines.zh: : 我找了。

lines.en: : I finally fucking did this time. And, you know...I really thought this was the one.
lines.zh: : 这次我终于找了。而且,你知道……我真的以为这次就是它了。

lines.en: : I really thought I could just fuckin’...live my life after all these years. That all the horrible shit was behind me and I could become someone worthy.
lines.zh: : 我真的以为,熬过这么多年,我终于可以他妈的……过自己的日子了。所有可怕的事都过去了,我可以变成一个配得上的人了。

lines.en: : Of Yumi...Sara...everybody who keeps givin’ me a chance when I ain’t done shit to earn one. But of course that was all a fuckin’ dream. Of course it wouldn’t actually work like that.
lines.zh: : 配得上 Yumi……Sara……每一个在我什么都没做时就一直给我机会的人。但当然,那全是一场该死的梦。当然不会真的那样运作。

lines.en: : What happened then?
lines.zh: : 后来发生了什么?

lines.en: : The fuck do you think happened, Rika? Gimme your best fuckin’ guess, because you ain’t gonna get it.
lines.zh: : 你觉得发生了什么,Rika?给你一次最好的猜测机会,因为你猜不到。

lines.en: : That’s why I’m asking. I know better than to ever expect an actual answer out of people like you. If you had one, things like this would never happen in the first place.
lines.zh: : 所以我才问。我早就明白,不该指望从你们这种人嘴里听到真实的答案。你们要是答得出来,这种事从一开始就不会发生。

lines.en: : Why even fucking ask then?
lines.zh: : 那你他妈还问什么?

lines.en: : Because it gets you talking. And talking makes you think. Talking makes you sad. Sadness is a spark.
lines.zh: : 因为问能让你开口。开口让你思考。思考让你悲伤。悲伤是火花。

lines.en: : So what, you’re trying to fuckin’ set me on fire now? Think I’m gonna pull myself together out of pure sorrow? What’s the plan?
lines.zh: : 所以呢,你想他妈的放火烧我?觉得我会出于纯粹的悲伤振作起来?你的计划是什么?

lines.en: : To make you fucking miserable. That’s the plan.
lines.zh: : 让你他妈的痛苦。计划就是这个。

lines.en: : Well, you ain’t gotta work hard at all then. Mission complete.
lines.zh: : 那你根本不用费劲。任务完成。

lines.en: : Oh, shut up. It’s not like I actually want you to be miserable. I just know that you need to hit rock bottom before you can find the strength to climb back up.
lines.zh: : 哦,闭嘴。我又不是真想让你痛苦。我只是知道,人得先跌到谷底,才能找到爬回去的力气。

lines.en: : I’m outta fuckin’ strength, Rika. I can’t do this shit anymore.
lines.zh: : 我他妈的力气用光了,Rika。这种事我再也做不动了。

lines.en: : Can I give you a little anecdote?
lines.zh: : 我可以给你讲个小故事吗?

lines.en: : Please. Anything to keep me from talkin’ about my fucking self.
lines.zh: : 求你了。什么都行,只要不让我聊我他妈的自己。

lines.en: : My daughter is adopted. My ex-partner and I both have vaginas, so we weren’t able to make a baby on our own.
lines.zh: : 我女儿是领养的。我和我的前任都有阴道,所以我们没办法自己生。

lines.en: : Great story. Have you sold the movie rights yet?
lines.zh: : 好故事。电影版权卖了吗?

lines.en: : Shush. I’m not done.
lines.zh: : 嘘。我还没讲完。

lines.en: : Her biological mom had her when she was just a kid. Probably close to the same age my daughter is right now.
lines.zh: : 她的生母生她的时候,自己还是个孩子。大概和我女儿现在的年纪差不多。

lines.en: : She was fucked up beyond belief. Not from drugs, I don’t think. Just, like...trauma in general? Weird brain stuff? But she could barely even speak apparently.
lines.zh: : 她当时的状态糟到难以置信。我觉得不是毒品。就是……广义的创伤?脑子里的怪毛病?据说她当时几乎连话都说不出来。

lines.en: : She was the definition of “rock bottom.” But even then...even though she was a fucking psycho, she managed to find the strength to do what was best for a baby and give her up to someone else.
lines.zh: : 她就是「谷底」的教科书定义。可即便是她……即便她是个该死的精神病,她还是找到了力气,做出对一个婴儿最好的事——把她交给别人。

lines.en: : And if a deranged, psychotic, borderline-mute lady can find it in herself to put others first, I think a conscious, drug addict Yakuza lady can definitely do the same.
lines.zh: : 如果一个精神失常、近于失语的女人都能先考虑别人,那么一个神志清醒的、女极道的瘾君子,绝对也能做到。

lines.en: : So...is the moral there...what? How does that relate to me exactly?
lines.zh: : 所以……这个故事的寓意……是什么?它跟我到底有什么关系?

lines.en: : You know. Rock bottom. Good decisions. Do things for your daughter, not yourself.
lines.zh: : 你懂的。谷底。正确的决定。为你的女儿做,而不是为你自己。

lines.en: : I guess it probably would have made more sense to talk about my dad being an addict too, huh?
lines.zh: : 我猜,其实聊我爸爸也是瘾君子,可能更贴题,啊?

lines.en: : That probably would have been better, yeah...
lines.zh: : 那确实可能更好一点,嗯……

lines.en: : Point is, tons of other people out there have crawled out from the bottom of the barrel and turned their lives around. You could be the next one. You’ve just gotta wake the fuck up.
lines.zh: : 重点是,世上有一大堆人从桶底爬出来、翻转了人生。你可以是下一个。你只需要他妈的醒过来。

lines.en: : Your daughter’s still your daughter, Yuki. She visits you. I’ve seen her outside. I’ve heard you guys watching wrestling through the walls. And I was only a little sad I wasn’t invited.
lines.zh: : 你的女儿永远是你的女儿,Yuki。她去看你。我在外面看到过。我隔着墙听到过你们一起看摔跤。我为没被邀请难过了那么一小下。

lines.en: : Didn’t...realize you were into that sorta thing.
lines.zh: : 没……想到你好这口。

lines.en: : Don’t do this to her. Or that Sara person I am now jealous of. Or any of the other people like Akira who love you.
lines.zh: : 别这样对她。也别这样对 Sara——我现在嫉妒的那位。或者任何爱你的人,比如 Akira。

lines.en: : You still ain’t gettin’ it, Rika. I’ve heard this all before...and it ain’t changed shit.
lines.zh: : 你还是没搞懂,Rika。这种话我都听腻了……它们什么也没改变。

lines.en: : Have you ever heard from your cool onee-san, though? That changes everything, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 不过,你那位酷酷的姐姐,后来有过消息吗?那可是一切都会变的理由,不是吗?

lines.en: : Heh...no. I guess I haven’t.
lines.zh: : 呵……不。我想是没有。

lines.en: : It doesn’t change anything, though.
lines.zh: : 但那也改变不了什么。

lines.en: : It’s too late, Rika.
lines.zh: : 太迟了,Rika。

lines.en: : I can’t keep crawlin’ up from rock bottom.
lines.zh: : 我没法一直从谷底往上爬。

lines.en: : Maybe...if I were more like you.
lines.zh: : 也许……如果我更像你一点。

lines.en: : Maybe if I was actually there for my daughter when she was little, I might’ve changed sooner. Gone to the gym more. Stayed away from shit everybody knows is bad for you...but feels so fucking good.
lines.zh: : 也许如果我女儿小的时候我真的陪着她,我可能早就变了。多去健身房。远离那些人人都知道有害……却爽得要命的东西。

lines.en: : Now, though?...
lines.zh: : 可是现在?……

lines.en: : The hell am I supposed to do when I’m not with Yumi, huh? When I’m not working? Just sit around and fucking...be alone with myself? You have any idea what I think of when I’m alone, Rika?
lines.zh: : 不和 Yumi 在一起的时候,我他妈该干嘛,啊?不上班的时候?就那么坐着,他妈的……和自己独处?你知不知道我独处的时候都在想什么,Rika?

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how bad the temptation is to just fucking...ruin everything again so that something’s happening? So that I’m not just reaping the benefits of a life I haven’t earned?
lines.zh: : 你知不知道「再毁掉一次一切、好让至少有事发生」的诱惑有多大?好让我不再白占一条我从未挣得的人生?

lines.en: : Combine those truths with the fact that the world just straight up doesn’t want people like me here and you get...
lines.zh: : 把这些真相,再叠加「这个世界根本不想要我这种人」的事实,你得到的就是……

lines.en: : Well...
: You get a fuckin’ death sentence.
lines.zh: : 你得到的是一张他妈的死刑判决。

lines.en: : I want you here, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 我要你在这里,Yuki。

lines.en: : You barely know me.
lines.zh: : 你几乎不认识我。

lines.en: : I barely knew my daughter at first too. Or my ex. Or all of my friends. But every one of them is extremely important to me now. And there’s no reason you can’t be too.
lines.zh: : 起初我也不怎么认识我女儿。或者我的前任。或者我的所有朋友。但如今她们每一个都对我极其重要。你凭什么不能也一样。

lines.en: : Sorry, I...
lines.zh: : 抱歉,我……

lines.en: : I just don’t...swing that way.
lines.zh: : 我就是……不好那口。

lines.en: : This isn’t about that! I’m not going to hit on you just a couple hours after you woke up from a drug-addled episode of breaking and entering! I want to be your friend!
lines.zh: : 跟这个没关系!我才不会在你刚从一次磕嗨了破门而入的状态里醒来两小时就搭讪你!我想当你的朋友!

lines.en: : Why, though?...I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 为什么?……我不懂。

lines.en: : Because I-
lines.zh: : 因为我——

lines.en: : Because I’m selfish.
lines.zh: : 因为我自私。

lines.en: : You...wouldn’t get it.
lines.zh: : 你……不会懂的。

lines.en: : Right! Anyway! Let’s work out!
lines.zh: : 对了!总之!我们锻炼吧!

lines.en: : Yeah. We stand around any longer, more people might start showin’ up and I won’t be able to talk about half of this shit anymore.
lines.zh: : 对。我们再站下去,可能要开始有人来了,到时这些话我就聊不成一半了。

lines.en: : We could always continue back at my place! Platonically, of course. Unless...
lines.zh: : 我们也可以回我家继续!柏拉图式的,当然。除非……

lines.en: : Ugh...why do I feel like you’re about to become a huge pain in my ass all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 唉……为什么我突然预感,你马上要变成我屁股上的一大块痛?

lines.en: : Probably because I am. I’ve never had a little sister before.
lines.zh: : 多半因为我是。我从来没有过小妹妹。

lines.en: : And you don’t have one now. ‘Specially since I still see you as like, a...twenty-something.
lines.zh: : 而你现在也没有。尤其在我眼里,你顶多是个……二十多岁的人。

lines.en: : It’s all that time on the elliptical! Oh, here. I’ll show you how to use it. Just come over here and- Yuki?
lines.zh: : 都是在椭圆机上练的!哦,过来。我教你用这个。你站到这边,然后——Yuki?

lines.en: : Sorry. I’m a punching bag only sorta girl. And I’ve got a lot of anger I need to get out right now.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我是「只打沙袋」派的。而且我现在有一大堆怒气需要发泄。

lines.en: Rika and Yuki have formed a bond!
lines.zh: Rika 和 Yuki 建立了羁绊!

lines.en: Yay?
lines.zh: : 可喜可贺?

lines.en: It’s noon again.
lines.zh: : 又是正午。
